# Observability Alignment

- Build receipt records source, exclusions, selected bytes, mappings, target baseline, and expected postimage.
- Validation receipt records every check including blocked or not-evaluable dependencies.
- Execution, if later authorized, must emit a per-path journal and stop at the first collision or source-digest drift.
- Admission, activation, publication, release, and deployment require separate owner evidence.
